purpose: Native model records and read access for the three explicitly approved upstream IDs; no service operations performed by this agent.

precheck.on_404: POST the corresponding payload below. The native access-update route creates the missing minimal base-model record before storing grants.
precheck.on_200: Require id match, base_model_id == null and is_active == true. If the public read grant already exists, skip the write. Otherwise preserve existing grants and append the grant_to_add; POST that merged grant list. Existing name/meta/params/owner are untouched by access-update.
stop_conditions: Existing record is a preset of another base_model_id
Existing anyone grant or user:* write grant requires review; do not erase or silently accept wider access
Unexpected ID or duplicate payload target

write.existing_record_semantics: access_grants replaces the complete grant set; merge existing grants in memory before submission. name only supplies the name when this route creates a missing record. Do not use /sync or model-delete/recreate.
write.upstream_calls: This route does not test the provider or call a model. A database record/grant alone does not prove inference or quota accounting.
write.partial_result_note: If native record creation succeeds but grant validation/write fails, a private record may remain. Re-read the exact ID before any retry; do not delete it automatically.

assert: no user:* write grant was introduced
existing record fields and grants remain preserved

normal_user_free_verification.identity: A legitimate normal OAuth user with a fresh provider-issued access/refresh token session
normal_user_free_verification.no_anonymous_access: user:* is the public-to-logged-in-user grant. Do not use principal_type=anyone. The native list/chat endpoints require a verified user/admin session; pending and anonymous users do not pass that dependency.
normal_user_free_verification.no_billing_bypass: Read grants only expose/use the model through native authorization. The NewAPI adapter independently requires the trusted mapped identity and enforces that user's balance on each billable call.
